decision: Free tiers of most dev platforms are not BAA-covered, so keep PHI off them. For a healthcare client, run a separate PHI stack in a cloud with a self-serve BAA and sign Common Paper's BAA downstream. A BAA does not make you compliant: risk analysis, access controls, audit logs and policies are still required.
details: Verify with a lawyer. No free option: a BAA is a contract with a paid service; clouds charge for HIPAA-eligible services and add-ons.

region_notes.US: HIPAA applies to US covered entities and their business associates.
region_notes.EU: Health data is special-category under GDPR; HIPAA is not the framework.
region_notes.UK: Health data follows UK GDPR; NHS buyers use DSPT.
region_notes.India: No HIPAA equivalent; DPDP applies (health specifics unverified).

verify.note: AWS BAA is accepted self-serve in AWS Artifact; commercial use is the whole point, so commercial_ok 'unclear' is wrong.
